description: Loads Limited manufactures radiators, exhaust systems, sheet-metal components and other parts for the automotive industry, and counts Toyota, Honda, Suzuki, Hino, Nissan, Isuzu, Massey-Ferguson, Mitsubishi and Yamaha among its customers. Established in 1979 and listed in 2016, it has four wholly owned subsidiaries — Specialized Autoparts Industries, Multiple Autoparts Industries, Specialized Motorcycles and Hi-tech Alloy Wheels.
